aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, heroic Hanumān; Master, victory to you, heroic Hanumān. Master, you are the reliever of troubles, steadfast in battle.
aarti.pad1: Son of the Wind, son of Añjanī, your glory is very great. Wipe away sorrow and poverty, O remover of every trouble. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: As a child you swallowed the sun; when the gods sang your praise, you let it go at once. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You brought about the friendship of the monkey Sugrīva with Śrī Rāma; you had mighty Vāli slain and won the throne for the monkey king. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: When you had burnt Laṅkā and brought news of Sītā, the monkeys rejoiced. You accomplished hard tasks and won Śrī Rāma's heart. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: When the Śakti weapon struck Lakṣmaṇa, there was great grief; you brought the Sañjīvanī herb and took all the sorrow away. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: When Ahirāvaṇa carried the Lord off and slipped into the netherworld, you slew him and brought the Lord back, and cries of victory rang out. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: At Ghāṭā Mehandipur the sight of you is splendid and very great; on Tuesdays and Saturdays a fair goes on there. ॥7॥
aarti.pad8: Whoever sings the āratī of Śrī Bālājī, says Indra, gains with a joyful heart the fruit he desires. ॥8॥
